ruleDefinitions.name: Python Spawning Pretty TTY on Windows
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects python spawning a pretty tty

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("python\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("python3\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("python2\\\.exe$")) AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*import\\ pty.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.spawn\\(.*")) OR process_command_line = RGX(".*from\\ pty\\ import\\ spawn.*"))
